name: unified_safe_system_e2r_anchored_lambdamart_v3
motivation_boundary: V1 unconstrained LambdaRank destroyed early EnzGFM ranking; V2 single-slot rank10 rescue improved every pooled metric but was too structurally conservative. V3 is a new baseline-anchored family on a brand-new salt, not a retuning of either revealed development set.

development_split.type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

experts.recipe_provenance: Exact fixed clean E2R expert recipe used by the prior audited families; no V3 backbone hyperparameter tuning.

candidate_universe.candidate_ids: lexically sorted registered general_merged reaction IDs common to all four experts

anchored_runtime_family.baseline_tail: All candidates not selected into the learned prefix preserve exact EnzGFM relative order.
anchored_runtime_family.interpretation: Protect the strongest baseline prefix exactly, let LambdaMART fill the remainder of a bounded prefix from the union of four expert shortlists, then append exact baseline tail.

ranker.family: XGBoost LambdaMART with baseline-rank monotonic anchor
ranker.training_pool: union of each expert Top-100 per query
ranker.training_sampling: all positives present in the union + 96 hardest union negatives by max expert z-score + 32 deterministic random remaining union negatives; queries without a positive in union contribute no pairwise gradient and are skipped for fitting
ranker.cross_fit: For each held-out development fold, ranker trains only on sampled groups from the other two development folds.
ranker.monotone_constraint: baseline_anchor prediction constraint +1; all other features unconstrained

development_gate.material_gain: pooled MRR delta >= 0.003 OR MAP delta >= 0.003 OR Hit@10 delta >= 0.01
development_gate.selection: Among configurations passing all pooled/fold/material constraints, maximize geometric mean of candidate/baseline ratios for MRR, MAP, NDCG@10 and Hit@10; then higher Hit@20 delta, then Hit@50 delta; then prefer larger protected prefix, smaller learned prefix/pool, shallower tree and fewer rounds.

forbidden: V1 folds 0/1/2 or V2 salted development metrics for V3 selection
confirmation salt/fold changes after development reveal
manual choice among feasible configurations after automatic ordering
